name: plumblog-tools
description: Contributor-only tooling (local Worker tests, admin build). Blog owners never need Node.

why.esbuild: admin bundle: TypeScript to minified ES modules with code splitting, one fast binary
why.typescript: type-checks the admin (tsc --noEmit); esbuild only strips types
why.playwright-core: admin screenshots and smoke tests in the system Chrome; no browser download
why.wrangler: runs the Worker locally (workerd, local D1/R2)
why.@codemirror/*: the admin editor: CodeMirror 6 (state, view, commands, language, lang-markdown); one version each, pinned together, because CM breaks when packages resolve different @codemirror/view copies
why.@lezer/markdown, @lezer/highlight: the Markdown parser and style tags CodeMirror's live styling reads (GFM tables, task lists, strikethrough)
